name: Hi.Events
description: Hi.Events is an event management and ticketing platform for conferences, concerts, workshops and club nights. Organizers sell free or paid tickets through Stripe with custom check-out questions, promo codes and capacity limits, manage attendees, check them in with the browser-based check-in app and embed ticket widgets in their own website.

notes.text: Open https://<IP>/auth/register, accept the self-signed certificate (sign-in only works over HTTPS) and create the first organizer. Sign-up stays open until you set APP_DISABLE_REGISTRATION=true in /opt/hi-events_data/.env.

Without SMTP presets, emails only go to the log in /opt/hi-events_data/storage/logs. For a domain or new IP, change the URLs in /opt/hi-events_data/.env and frontend.env, then restart the hi-events services.
Hi.Events is AGPL-3.0 with an added term: the "Powered by Hi.Events" footer must stay visible unless you buy a licence.

app_vars.name: var_smtp_host
app_vars.label: SMTP Host
app_vars.help: Leave empty to write emails to the log instead of sending them

app_vars.name: var_smtp_port
app_vars.label: SMTP Port
app_vars.help: 465 uses implicit TLS, other ports STARTTLS
